findings.brand: ZDM wordmark + lime segmented download arrow icon (src-tauri/icons/icon.png, src/assets/zdm-icon.png); lime #c6f24e is the brand accent (segment strip, chart line, speed figures). Brand stays at every depth: lime accent, icon, wordmark, segment strip.
findings.fonts: Inter variable via @font-face (src/styles.css), bundled @fontsource-variable/inter; no other faces. Hallmark will replace the display/body face with Host Grotesk and add Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono for measured figures (both installed from @fontsource, bundled woff2, no network at runtime).
findings.framework: Tauri v2 + Vite 6 + vanilla TypeScript frontend (src/main.ts, src/styles.css, index.html); Rust backend untouched by this redesign. Shell: 224px sticky sidebar + 64px topbar, #app 100dvh, only main#content scrolls on desktop; Menu sheet at <=900px.
findings.motion: 120ms colour-only transitions on .btn/.nav-item/.tab/.day-btn, :active states, disabled under prefers-reduced-motion (src/styles.css, premium pass). No reveal on load.
findings.palette: :root tokens in src/styles.css: ground #000000, surface #111111, raised #2a2a2a, border #1a1a1a, rule #161616, text #ffffff, muted #b4b4b4, faint #949494, accent lime #c6f24e (brand), accent-bright #eaffb0, negative #e5484d / negative-text #ff6b6b, warning #e5a93b. Pure absolute #000 ground (gate 7b Reflex).
findings.signals: No design.md. No .hallmark/brand-spec.md. Genre inferred modern-minimal (developer tool). Theme dealt: Console (dark, graphites, Host Grotesk + Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono), deal 1/3.
findings.spacing: One gutter: 22px outside, 16px between panels, 20px panel padding; bento 12 cols gap 16; type scale 12/14/16/20/24, weights 400/500/600, tracking 0 (wordmark 0.04em brand exception); radius card 20px, control 999px.

inferences.audience: The user himself (Zulian), a technical power user who works in the tool for long sessions and reads it at a glance.
inferences.material: The app itself and its real data (downloads, speeds, sizes, ETAs, checksums). No photos, no invented figures; sample data only in preview files, never shipped.
inferences.tone: modern-minimal, technical, instrument-like. Console theme: a lab notebook kept by a careful person.
inferences.use: Manage downloads as fast as possible: see what is running, how fast, when it finishes; start/stop the queue; add a URL in one click.

introduce: Console theme system: graphite ground in three lightness steps, hairline panels cut from one surface, radius 10px card / 6px control, Host Grotesk 500 reading face, Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono for measured figures.
tokens.css + base.css from the Hallmark scaffold (scope app, redesign full); all colours and fonts through :root tokens (Floor 1).
Audit-trail treatment of the timeline (rule-2 spine, mono timestamps) and Readings treatment of the speed figure (mono at display size).
Eight-state controls, instant :focus-visible rings, inset input rings, instant tooltips on focus.
Hallmark stamp, critique line, waivers and log in .hallmark/.
preserve: All content, wiring, element IDs, Tauri commands and behaviours (redesign.md: content + wiring stay).
Brand: lime #c6f24e accent, ZDM wordmark + icon, per-download segment strip.
Shell behaviour: 224px sticky sidebar, #app 100dvh, only main#content scrolls on desktop; Menu sheet on phone.
Type scale discipline (one scale, tabular figures) and the bento + timeline composition's data (day groups, scrubber, speed chart, vitals) — recomposed, not removed.
